description.value: Tasty Market and Cafe is a cozy neighbourhood market and café in Vancouver's Chinatown, centred on locally sourced organic produce, groceries, and household staples. The café side pours locally roasted organic and Fair Trade coffee alongside sandwiches, pasta dishes, and comfort food served for breakfast and lunch. It is a community-rooted stop in a dense urban cycling corridor.
